post1.quote: We support commercial deep-sea mining to expand battery-metal supplies.

post2.quote: Commercial deep-sea mining belongs in our supply strategy, alongside recycling and responsible production on land.

post3.quote: We back a broader supply of battery metals.

paragraph.quote: we believe commercial deep-sea mining deserves a place in that effort.

raw.note_quote: Deep-sea mining cannot be guaranteed to end battery-metal shortages. These drafts advocate for it without presenting that prediction as fact.
